## Introduction

We are interested in adding more datasets to the Treehouse Splice Compendium prior to submitting the manuscript to a journal.
Currently, the priorities are to include samples in the Treehouse polyA compendia,
with healthy comparators from dGTEx.

This notebook reads in the clinical metadata from the v25 Treehouse PolyA Compendium and explores how many samples in each disease type are represented.
